title: GitHub Trending Today #13: react2shell-scanner, Paper2Slides, CloudMeet, Openinary, pbnj, try-cli

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: In today's episode, GitHub trending today number 13. We've got 27 trending reposing developer tools, cyber security that are blowing up on GitHub right now. Let's go.

sections.title: Open Claude
paragraphs: Open Claude is a native Mac OS desktop client for Claude designed with a clean, minimal interface and systemwide quick access. It offers a floating spotlight style search bar, transparent vibrancy windows, and seamless conversation management. conversation context preservation, streaming responses, and secure authentication via your existing Claude account. Open Claude brings the full power of Claude directly to your Mac desktop.

sections.title: react2shell-scanner
paragraphs: React to Shell Scanner is a command line security tool that detects two newly disclosed NexJS rce vulnerabilities. This scanner performs a realistic and deterministic check by sending a crafted multi-art request and verifying its execution response, giving you a confident vulnerability signal. If you're responsible for securing Nex.js deployments, this is currently one of the reliable ways to evaluate exposure to the recent React to shell remote code execution issue.

sections.title: Clipboard to Markdown
paragraphs: Clipboard to Markdown is a handy Chrome extension that lets you grab any element on a web page and instantly copy it as clean markdown or even as a PNG screenshot. Just press a shortcut, click something on the page, and the extension converts the selected HTML with turndown or captures a clipped screenshot and places it right into your clipboard.

sections.title: Paper2Slides
paragraphs: Papertoslides instantly transforms your research papers and technical documents into slide decks and posters with just one click. It supports PDFs, word files, even markdown all processed together in one workflow. With its rag powered content extraction, result and insight is captured accurately and linked back to the original source so nothing gets lost. You can choose professional themes or even describe your own design in plain language for custom styling.

sections.title: CloudMeet
paragraphs: Kalanley is cool, but what if you could self-host it for free? Meet Cloud Meet, a simple open-source meetinguler that runs entirely on Cloudflare's free tier. Connect Google Calendar, Outlook calendar, or even both at the same time. Cloud Meet automatically creates meetings with Google Meet or Microsoft Teams links. No copy paste required. Deploy it to Cloudflare in a click using GitHub actions. Update it with one command and you're done.

sections.title: StoryGen Atelier
paragraphs: Story genitalier is an AI powered storyboard and video generation tool designed for filmmakers and creators. It uses Gemini to produce storyboard scripts and visual frames, then calls Vertex AI VO to generate transition clips. Finally, stitching everything together into a video with FFmpeg. You can customize styles, control shot counts, save outputs in a gallery, and review logs through an integrated dashboard with persistent storage.

sections.title: Openinary
paragraphs: Open an area is a self-hostable alternative to Cloudinary for processing and delivering images and videos with on the-fly transformations. It gives you full control over your media infrastructure. Resize and optimize assets directly through a simple URL-based API with automatic conversion to modern codecs, built-in caching, and native support for S3 compatible storage like AWS and Cloudflare R2. Open Inary offers high performance media delivery without vendor lockin.

sections.title: pbnj
paragraphs: PB&J is a self-hosted paste bin designed to be fast and easy to deploy without the heavy features or dependencies that complicate most alternatives. It supports syntax highlighting for over a 100 languages, offers memorable sharable URLs, lets you publish from the CLI with a single command, and even runs globally on Cloudflare for free with a clean UI, private pastes, and optional secret keys. PB&J focuses on simplicity and ownership.

sections.title: Pingora Proxy Manager
paragraphs: Pingora Proxy Manager is a high performance reverse proxy built on Cloudflare's Pingora and written in Rust. It supports zero downtime configuration, automatic SSL using HTTP01 and DNS01 challenges, including wildcard certificates, and provides a clean dashboard for managing virtual hosts, path routing, and access control.

sections.title: App Store Screenshot Generator
paragraphs: Appscreen is a free app store screenshot generator that helps you produce beautiful, professionallook iOS and iPad OS screenshots using customizable backgrounds, text overlays, and realistic device mockups. It supports batch exporting, multi- language layouts, 2D and interactive 3D device views, and lets you fine-tune typography, gradients, shadows, borders, and screenshot placement with pixel level control.

sections.title: try-cli
paragraphs: Trioli is a minimalist C implementation for managing your experiment directories, giving every project its own fresh, organized home. No more messy test one, test two, new test folders or coding in TMP and losing work. Try automatically creates timestamp directories, lets you fuzzy search through experiments, and sorts them by recent activity. Blazing fast, and a single statically linked binary.

sections.title: retropad
paragraphs: Retropad is a Win32 Notepad clone written mostly in plain C. Inspired by Pzled's classic style, it keeps the familiar menus, accelerators, word wrap toggle, status bar, font picker, and time insertion. Printing is intentionally omitted, focusing instead on a clean, lightweight editing experience. Built for Windows with MSVC or optionally MinW, Retropad is perfect for developers who love classic Notepad functionality.

sections.title: QMD
paragraphs: QMD is an ondevice search engine designed specifically for markdown notes, knowledge bases, transcripts, and personal documentation. Instead of sending your information to the cloud, QMD runs everything locally using a lama, combining BM25 full text search, vector semantic search, and LLM re-ranking into one workflow.

sections.title: The Rosetta Prompt
paragraphs: The Rosetta prompt is a prompt optimization system that adapts your AI prompts to work seamlessly across different AI providers. Unlike simple prompt inprompt out tools, each optimizer agent acts autonomously. It discovers documentation, selectively reads provider guidelines, applies learned transformations, and reports structured changes with a detailed change log.

sections.title: Peinture
paragraphs: Ponur AI image generator built with React leveraging hugging face models like Z image turbo and Quen image fast for lightning fast highquality image generation from text prompts. It offers multimodel support, AI powered prompt enhancement, and a local history gallery where you can manage your creations with interactive zooming and a privacy focused design that keeps all data in your browser.

sections.title: Scanify
paragraphs: Scannify is a handy tool that transforms ordinary PDFs to look like authentic scanned documents. It applies base effects like paper darkening, edge shadows, uneven lighting, and subtle rotation to mimic real scanner imperfections. For added realism, optional flags let you go aggressive with stronger artifacts, add bent paper shadows, or sprinkle random dust and hair fibers.

sections.title: NotchPrompter
paragraphs: Notch prompter is a lightweight, always on top floating text prompter for Mac OS. Ideal for quick videos or keeping important text visible while you work. It features a minimalist design, voice activation, adjustable speed and size, and pauses automatically when you hover over it. Simple, unobtrusive, and effective. Notchrompter keeps your focus on your content without cluttering your screen.

sections.title: PyCharting
paragraphs: Pie charting is a Python charting library for visualizing financial data with technical indicators. It lets you render massive OLC time series, hundreds of thousands to millions of candles directly in the browser with a single Python call. Running a lightweight fast API server and using uplot on the front end, pie charting provides interactive charts with overlays, indicator subplots like RSI or stochastic oscillators.

sections.title: DB Studio
paragraphs: DB Studio universal database management tool. Think of it as a PG admin alternative that works with any SQL database and launches directly from the CLI. It features a high performance virtual data grid, a command pallet for fast navigation, table management with column types and foreign keys, and efficient record operations with form validation.

sections.title: LongCat-Image
paragraphs: Longcat image is a foundation model for image generation designed to tackle multilingual text rendering and developer accessibility. With only 6B parameters, it outperforms many much larger open-source models across benchmarks while remaining highly efficient. The LongCat imageedit variant delivers state-of-the-art instruction following and image editing with excellent visual consistency.

sections.title: hyprsnow
paragraphs: Hypers snow is a playful snow overlay for Wayland Hyperland, adding falling snowflakes that land on window title bars and the bottom of your screen before melting away. Fully configurable, you can adjust snow intensity, flake size, fall speed, and horizontal drift either via CLI options or a config file.

sections.title: imsg
paragraphs: EMSG is a Mac OS CLI tool for sending, reading, and streaming iMessage and SMS messages directly from the terminal. It allows you to list chats, view message history, and tail new messages in real time. Sending text and attachments is handled via Applecript while read operations access the database in a readonly mode. Context engine is a portable drop-in tool for capturing and

sections.title: ContextEngine
paragraphs: managing engineering decisions, constraints, and architectural knowledge across projects. Built to work with Cloud Code CLI, it lets you capture session knowledge as structured YAML chat logs, extract rules into a queryable SQLite database, and optimize tags using AI assisted reasoning with human oversight.

sections.title: Diapasonix
paragraphs: Diaposics is a portable electronic instrument and MIDI controller that feels like a stringed instrument, but packs modern synth power. With a capacitive touchpad fretboard, four strings, six frets, and a layout configurable to mimic guitar, bass, ukulele, or violin, anyone familiar with stringed instruments can start playing immediately.

sections.title: Geometric Constraint Solver
paragraphs: Geometric Constraint Solver is a minimal educational tool that demonstrates how CAD programs solve geometric constraints written in pure Go with only about 2,000 lines of code. It represents constraints as nonlinear equations and solves them using a multi-dimensional Newton's method. It includes a simple symbolic algebra system for calculating derivatives, a short math summary.

sections.title: PromptForge
paragraphs: Prompt Forge is a visual prompt management system for AI image generation designed to help artists and creators organize, browse, and manage prompts with visual references. It features a visual catalog with hundreds of artistic styles, organized pages and categories, and interactive cards that reveal detailed prompt descriptions on hover with one-click copying, full CRUD operations, and import export capabilities.

sections.title: qs-hyprview
paragraphs: QS HyperView is a highly customizable window switcher for Hyperland inspired by Mac OS mission control and Gnome activities built entirely in QML with the quick shell framework. It leverages cute 6 and Wayland layer shell to deliver zero latency 60fps animations and a truly native Wayland experience. QS HyperView turns your workspace into a visually elegant and highly productive window overview.
